chunks: Al-Khalil ibn Ahmad told me, saying: Abu Ja'far al-Daybali narrated to us, saying: Abu Abdullah narrated to us, saying: Sufyan narrated to us, from Ayyub al-Sakhtiani, from Ikrimah, from Ibn Abbas, who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:

Whoever constructs an image shall be punished and will be commanded to give it life, but he cannot do so. And whoever lies in his dream shall be punished and commanded to tie together two strands of barley, but he cannot do so. And whoever eavesdrops on a conversation while they are unwilling for him to listen, molten lead shall be poured into his ears on the Day of Resurrection. Sufyan said: 'Al-annak' is from lead.
ai.seo_question: What are the three types of people who will be punished on the Day of Resurrection according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Al-Khisal* details three specific transgressions—image-making, lying in dreams, and eavesdroing—that incur distinct eschatological punishments, illustrating the severity of mimicking divine creation. The imagery of being forced to breathe life into inanimate images or tie barley strands while unable to succeed highlights the futility of their efforts, a concept deeply rooted in Shia exegetical traditions regarding the *Barzakh* and Resurrection. These punishments serve as practical warnings for believers to guard their tongues and eyes, preserving the sanctity of divine attributes.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 3-77 Al-Khalil ibn Ahmad narrated that Abu Ja’far al-Daybali quoted on the authority of Abu Abdullah, on the authority of Sufyan, on the authority of Ayoob Al-Sakhtiani, on the authority of Akrama, on the authority of Ibn Abbas that God’s Prophet (MGB) said, “

Whoever constructs an image shall be punished and will have to give it life which he cannot do. Whoever lies about a dream will be punished until he ties up two pieces of barley which cannot be tied together. On the Resurrection Day, molten lead shall be poured into the ears of whoever eavesdrops on someone as this is considered to be bad to do.” Sufyan said, “Molten lead comes from solder.”
